title: Percutaneous Vertebroplasty Versus Conservative Treatment of Pain
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to compare the effect of vertebroplasty with that of traditional medical treatment in the treatment of painful vertebral fractures in osteoporotic patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* new pain in spine (within 6 months)
* x-ray verified low energy spinal fracture(s)

Exclusion Criteria:

* less than 20% or more than 90% reduction of the vertebral height
* lack of pain at fracture level
* no need for continuous analgesic treatment
* patient no able to communicate
* general anaesthesia contraindicated
* MRI not possible
* coagulopathy (not adjustable)
* spondylitis
* discitis
* spinal metastasis
